description: Returns the current National Weather Service forecast for a US point.  This is a forecast, not a record of observed weather.  Send latitude and longitude (no key needed), or a U.S. street address (needs the free key).  Returns 12-hour periods for about seven days and hourly values, with issued_utc, the time the National Weather Service issued it, and a stale flag.  U.S. coverage only.

address.description: Full U.S. street address with city, state and ZIP (needs the free key)

name: get_forecast
title: Get the current National Weather Service forecast
